claim_ceiling: Confirms that three independently qualified synthetic evaluators carry the same declared scope digest. It does not instantiate or qualify an integrated district, align the scenario semantics of the cases, authenticate live owner receipts, or establish real service, asset, engineering or physical conditions.

service_horizon.note: The three benchmark corpora test distinct event and decision horizons; they are not one synchronized district timeline.

design_and_bom_revisions.note: Each corpus retains its own synthetic owner/source revisions.

evidence_policy.note: No municipal or project evidence policy is asserted.

integration.payload_bytes_verified: synthetic fixtures only; no live payload bytes
integration.rule: A shared scope digest is a necessary identity condition, not sufficient evidence of equivalent scenario, functional unit, design revision, temporal horizon or physical state. Never promote the three independent PASS receipts into an integrated district PASS.

evaluators.qualification: 36/36 synthetic cases; 16/16 Rust tests; format and strict Clippy passed
32/32 synthetic cases; 14/14 Rust tests; format and strict Clippy passed
28/28 synthetic cases and 42/42 claim projections; 7/7 Rust tests; format and strict Clippy passed; mismatched report scope digest negative control passed

required_next_gates: Bind one explicit synthetic district scenario, time horizon and asset/design/BOM revision set; keep each owner functional unit separately typed.
Run the shared scope binder (#623/#624) over exact owner/schema/subject/scope envelopes; register each native schema under #606.
Resolve exact source artifacts and use the payload-byte verifier (#500/#637); a declared digest string is not payload verification.
Produce one scenario-aligned cross-owner fixture linking one dwelling/panel asset, its service requirements, a material lot, an intervention plan and the dependent claims.
Run cross-owner wrong-scope, wrong-revision, revoked-lot, stale-state, missing-dependency, unavailable-resource and incomplete-revalidation controls.

Emit an integrated receipt only when all required owner receipts are current, scope- and scenario-compatible, and the independent composition oracle agrees. Otherwise return Unknown/Blocked/NotComparable.
explicit_non_claims: No real Johannesburg site, boundary or parcel
No surveyed building or as-built geometry
No physical construction or robot performance claim
No integrated district resilience, sustainability or operational outcome claim
